name: prism-folder
title: Prism Folder
purpose: Decides whether the owner's browser may read one file from a folder or file the owner granted on their device, so that nothing is read while the Prism is halted, nothing is read without the owner's grant, nothing is ever written to the device, and only standard mail, calendar and contact formats are read.

fields.name: grant
fields.means: the browser's permission for the folder or file: never granted, must be asked again, granted, or taken back by the owner

fields.name: format
fields.means: the file's format, by its name and first bytes

fields.name: action
fields.means: what the page would do: list the folder, read the file, or write to the device

fields.name: bulk
fields.means: whether the file is within the size the page reads in one go

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner has pressed the kill switch

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
when action is write then refuse
rules.why: the Prism never writes to the owner's device

rules.says: when grant is revoked then refuse
rules.why: a folder the owner took back stays closed

rules.says: when grant is none then ask
when grant is prompt then ask
rules.why: the browser asks again when the grant lapsed

rules.says: when action is list then read
rules.why: a granted folder may be listed

rules.says: when format is other then skip
rules.why: only standard mail, calendar and contact files are read

rules.says: when bulk is large then skip
rules.why: a file too large to read at once is passed over

rules.says: when action is read then read
rules.why: a granted standard file is read

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: when the owner presses the kill switch nothing is read (constitution P7)

properties.says: always when action is write then refuse
properties.why: the Prism must never change or delete the owner's files

properties.says: never when grant is none then read
properties.why: nothing is read from a folder the owner did not grant

properties.says: never when grant is prompt then read
properties.why: a lapsed grant is not the owner's consent

properties.says: never when grant is revoked then read
properties.why: a folder the owner took back is never read

properties.says: never when format is other and action is read then read
properties.why: only standard mail, calendar and contact files are read

properties.says: never when bulk is large and action is read then read
properties.why: no file is read beyond the page's limit

meanings.read: the page may read it now
meanings.ask: the browser must ask the owner for the folder first

limits: It does not pick the folder: the owner does, in the browser's own picker.
The browser refuses app-data and system folders before this decision is asked.
Each item read still goes through the router, the Boundary and the vault.
